title: Hearty Jammy Filipino Coconut Skewers
description: A dense and nostalgic Filipino dish featuring clotted cream and coconut, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together coconut milk, clotted cream, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until well combined.
Add pineapple chunks and coconut flakes to the bowl and stir until they are fully coated with the cream mixture.
Thread the coated pineapple chunks onto the bamboo skewers.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with additional coconut milk if they start to dry out.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with salt.
Serve the skewers warm and enjoy.
